The '''Republic Swift Fleet''' was a military [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Following the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Krath Holy Crusade|offensive]], this fleet launched a counter-attack throughout [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]], starting from [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]] and ending at [[Boonta/Legends|Ko Vari]].<ref name="TEA" /> It notably participated during the [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|Battle]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]<ref name="TOTJTSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref><ref name="TEA" /> and [[Battle of Ko Vari (Boonta)|devastated]] much of the Krath fleet at Ko Vari.<ref name="TEA" />
